name: salesforce-imports
description: Why did my Salesforce import fail, and should I insert, update, or upsert these records? Explain rejected Salesforce import rows and choose insert, update, upsert, or an object-specific match key from pasted errors, exports, and screenshots or their descriptions. Use when an import failed, an external ID is not matching, or an upload might create duplicates. Returns a repair and retry plan or an operation and mapping recommendation. Not for running imports, changing duplicate rules, or general CRM administration.
